entries.title: Job 4:1
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content:
1 Eliphaz reproves Job for want of religion. 7 He teaches God's judgments to be not for the righteous, but for the wicked. 12 His fearful vision to humble the excellency of creatures before God.

Eliphaz. 2:11; 15:1; 22:1; 42:9 answered. 3:1,2; 6:1; 8:1

entries.title: Job 4:2
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: to commune. Heb. a word. wilt thou. 2Co 2:4-6; 7:8-10 withhold himself from speaking. Heb. refrain from words. 32:18-20; Jer 6:11; 20:9; Ac 4:20

entries.title: Job 4:4
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: upholden. Ps 145:14; Pr 12:18; 16:23,24; 2Co 2:7; 7:6; 1Th 5:14 feeble knees. Heb. bowing knees. Isa 35:3,4; Da 5:6; Heb 12:12

entries.title: Job 4:5
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: it is come. 3:25,26 thou faintest. Pr 24:10; 2Co 4:1,16; Heb 12:3,5 it toucheth. 1:11; 2:5; 19:21

entries.title: Job 4:9
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: the blast. Ex 15:8,10; 2Ki 19:7; Ps 18:15 by the breath of his nostrils. that is, by his anger. 1:19; 15:30; Isa 11:4; 30:33; 2Th 2:8; Re 2:16

entries.title: Job 4:12
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: a thing. Ps 62:11 secretly. Heb. by stealth. a little. 1Co 13:12

entries.title: Job 4:14
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: Fear. 7:14; Ps 119:120; Isa 6:5; Da 10:11; Hab 3:16; Lu 1:12,29; Re 1:17 came upon. Heb. met. all my bones. Heb. the multitude ofmy bones. 33:19

entries.title: Job 4:16
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: there, etc. or, I heard a still voice. 1Ki 19:12

entries.title: Job 4:18
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: he put. 15:15,16; 25:5,6; Ps 103:20,21; 104:4; Isa 6:2,3 and his angels he charged with folly. or, nor in his angelsin whom he put light. 2Pe 2:4; Jude 1:6

entries.title: Job 4:20
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: destroyed. Heb. beaten in pieces. 2Ch 15:6; *marg from morning. Isa 38:12,13 they perish. 14:14; 16:22; Ps 39:13; 92:7 without. 18:17; 20:7; 2Ch 21:20; Ps 37:36; Pr 10:7
